verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no real-time dashboard for live system metrics or worker/browser pool status. The closest item is the Usage API, which programmatically returns real-time credit and concurrency usage. That is an adjacent API endpoint, not a monitoring dashboard, and it does not report worker or browser pool health. The authenticated dashboard is only documented as hosting a Request Builder.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard

citations.quote: Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated ScrapingBee account.
